mapper.select: SELECT i.*, a.version AS asset_version FROM afv_asset_item i JOIN afv_asset a ON a.id = i.asset_id AND a.deleted = FALSE WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.asset_id IN #{assetId} ORDER BY i.asset_id, i.sort_order, i.id
mapper.sql: i.id, i.version, i.asset_id, a.version AS asset_version, i.name, i.item_type, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.properties, '$.appearanceDescription')) = 'STRING' THEN LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.properties, '$.appearanceDescription')), 200) WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.properties, '$.appearance')) = 'STRING' THEN LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.properties, '$.appearance')), 200) WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.properties, '$.description')) = 'STRING' THEN LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.properties, '$.description')), 200) END AS description_preview, (i.image_url IS NOT NULL AND i.image_url != '') AS has_image
mapper.select: SELECT FROM afv_asset_item i JOIN afv_asset a ON a.id = i.asset_id AND a.deleted = FALSE WHERE i.asset_id = #{assetId} AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id

SELECT FROM ( SELECT i.id, i.asset_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.asset_id ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id) AS item_position FROM afv_asset_item i WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.asset_id IN #{assetId} ) ranked JOIN afv_asset_item i ON i.id = ranked.id JOIN afv_asset a ON a.id = ranked.asset_id AND a.deleted = FALSE WHERE ranked.item_position > #{offset} AND ranked.item_position <= #{end} ORDER BY ranked.asset_id, ranked.item_position
SELECT asset_id FROM afv_asset_item WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM afv_asset_item WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND name = #{name} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM afv_asset_item WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY sort_order, id FOR UPDATE
